lines.t: In the beginning, his voice moved across the void, calling light out of darkness.
From the silence he speaks again
Through the void, through the end
A trembling word, a hidden flame
In the dark, his truth remains
He calls from the midst of the fire
I heard the call from the ancient one
His word breaks chains, his truth resounds
Shakes the heavens, splits the ground
Let every heart be filled with fear
At the sound of His decree
Woe to those who turn aside, who love the dark and try to hide.
His word is like a sharpened blade, cuts through every lie we've made.
Still his mercy calls us home, no more lost and no more alone.
Turn and lift the hours now, every soul must choose and bow.
Hear the trumpet loud and clear
The day of God is drawing near
Prepare the way, make straight the path
Fire in His eyes, forever He remains
At the sound of his decree
Every eye will see his face
His word is faithful, his word is true
From age to age he stays the same
Lift your hands, prepare the way
The King of glory comes today.
Let the nation shout his praise.
Let his fire fill this place.
Heaven and earth declare his name.
In the power of his light
The truth, the way, the life
